captures.note: two MP3s play in order with a loading part in the middle. mp3#1 starts at 6.41s, mp3#2 at 106.72s. mp3#1 is cut early (would run to 117.4s) - matches FSOUND_StopSound in the import list; mp3#2 would end at 225.8s but the capture ends at 219.1s. mp3#2 was originally pinned at 106.96s by a 10ms log-energy correlation and RE-MEASURED to 106.720s by work/verify/align.mjs, which correlates a moving-mean-subtracted amplitude envelope (onsets, not loudness) at 1ms resolution over three disjoint 30s excerpts. The excerpts agree to 3ms, and the same instrument reproduces mp3#1's pin to 11ms, so the 240ms is specific to track 2 and not estimator bias. Independently corroborated: sweeping render time against fixed reference frames put EVERY phase-2 part 0.15-0.30s early under the old pin, and no phase-1 part.
